title: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.21436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An {\epsilon}-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. translated_title: HyCo：面向高性价比移动-云协同推测解码的混合草稿生成机制
translated_abstract: 设备-云协同推测解码能够减少服务器的计算开销，但使用小型语言模型（SLM）生成深度草稿树需要在移动神经处理单元（NPU）上进行多次推理。我们提出了HyCo，它将草稿深度分配给在设备端执行的服务器模型原生多词预测（MTP）头，并将替代分支分配给单次SLM推理。服务器只需返回该MTP头所需的隐状态、输入嵌入和键值缓存条目，而无需执行其原有的顺序计算步骤。通过量化、受限词表和1K-token窗口设置，两个草稿模型均能适配NPU运行。此外，一种ε阈值规则进一步放宽了对验证器采样分布的精确保持要求。在通过LTE/5G网络连接Galaxy S26 Ultra的单客户端运行中，与服务器端MTP自推测相比，HyCo在Spec-Bench上将每个输出token的服务器GPU时间降低了38.6%，在32K-token摘要任务上降低了29.2%。
tldr: HyCo提出混合草稿生成机制，将服务器模型的原生多词预测头部署到移动NPU上并与小型语言模型单次推理协同工作，配合量化和ε阈值松弛策略，使移动-云推测解码的服务器GPU时间降低约29%-39%。
en_tdlr: HyCo proposes a hybrid drafting scheme that deploys the server model's native multi-token prediction head on the mobile NPU alongside a single SLM pass, using quantization and an ε-threshold relaxation to cut server GPU time in mobile-cloud speculative decoding by roughly 29-39%.
